title: Wynncraft Xtra
description: Every Wynncraft Modpack I tried lacked certain mods or was bloated so i just made my own with Wynncraft Xtra you have everything you need for Wynncraft in one Modpack
body: Wynncraft Xtra is a Modpack specifically made for Wynncraft it enhances the player experience and adds many things it has everything you need or might search for its unlike the other modpacks that lack certain Wynncraft add ons or Performance mods Wynncraft Xtra includes mods like Wynntils and Voices of Wynn which make the overall Wynncraft gameplay much smoother Wynncraft Xtra is perfect for beginners or people who have not played Wynncraft before this should make their Wynncraft experience overall much better whilst not having bloat or missing features (NOT AFFILIATED WITH WYNNCRAFT)
